reason: A dsh web authentication reverse proxy that gates HTTP and WebSocket access with a static token, optional IP allowlisting, and configurable local or private-network listening.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh web 提供带静态令牌登录页、会话 Cookie、IP 白名单和 HTTP/WebSocket 转发的鉴权反向代理。
summaries.en: An authentication reverse proxy for dsh web that provides static-token login, session cookies, IP allowlisting, and HTTP/WebSocket forwarding.

capabilities: Listens on a configurable local or private-network HTTP socket
Validates a static access token through a built-in login page
Issues and validates signed session cookies
Proxies HTTP and WebSocket traffic to a loopback dsh webserver
Supports IP allowlisting and per-IP failed-login lockouts
Reads and persists plugin settings through the host settings scope
